title: Russkaja Latinica (Russian Latin)
description: Latinizes the Russian localization of Minecraft, according to the Russkaja Latinica project.
body:
Latinizes the Russian localization of Minecraft, according to the Russkaja Latinica project.  

Латинизирует русскую локализацию майнкрафт, по проекту Russkaja Latinica

Latinizirujet russkuju lokalizacyju majnkraft, po proektu Russkaja Latinica.
